pavo_core

Module cache 

Source
Expand description

A small TTL cache — Mutex<HashMap> + Instant expiries, std-only.

Used by crate::host::Host for view-model results; renderers and CLI verbs can also hold one for repeated resolve_view calls. Keys are caller-chosen strings; values must be Clone (hits clone out — the cache never hands out references into the lock).
